Done right the first time. | About Kitto Sheds & Equipment | 01 | Our History | Founded in 2005, Kitto Equipment was started by Allan Kitto along with his parents Kevin and Jill Kitto. They specialized in farm tractors and construction equipment. During the 2008 recession they added tire disposal, equipment rental and metal sheds and carports. Over the years, the business has grown requiring more land, a larger building, and more employees. The business has evolved in many directions and the 'Kitto Crew' can be seen throughout the county and involved in many community functions. | 02 | Our Expertise | Kitto Sheds & Equipment has many facets — sheds, carports, horse barns, boat covers, pump covers, steel buildings, concrete work, equipment rentals, truck parts & service, welding & fabrication, equipment transport, and tire disposal. We are a family owned local business and proud to say most of our work comes from referrals. If we can't solve it ourselves, we'll connect you with a trusted partner who can. | 03 | Our Process | We keep it simple: you call, we come out, we get it done. We're happy to visit your job site, assess your needs, and walk you through every step — from permits to final build. We stay in communication throughout the project and don't consider the job finished until you're satisfied. One team. One contract.
